helm.values:
backend:
    replicas: 0
chunksCache:
    enabled: false
compactor:
    extraEnvFrom:
        - secretRef:
              name: loki-s3-linode-credentials
    replicas: 1
    resources:
        limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 256Mi
        requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 128Mi
deploymentMode: Distributed
distributor:
    autoscaling:
        enabled: false
        maxReplicas: 3
        minReplicas: 1
        targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
        targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80
    extraEnvFrom:
        - secretRef:
              name: loki-s3-linode-credentials
    replicas: 1
    resources:
        limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        requests:
            cpu: 150m
            memory: 128Mi
gateway:
    autoscaling:
        enabled: false
        maxReplicas: 3
        minReplicas: 1
        targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
        targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80
    image:
        repository: docker/nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged
    replicas: 1
    resources:
        limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 256Mi
        requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
global:
    dnsService: coredns
    image:
        registry: mirror.registry.linodelke.net
    priorityClassName: otomi-critical
indexGateway:
    extraEnvFrom:
        - secretRef:
              name: loki-s3-linode-credentials
    replicas: 1
    resources:
        limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 256Mi
        requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
ingester:
    autoscaling:
        enabled: false
        maxReplicas: 3
        minReplicas: 1
        targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
        targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80
    extraEnvFrom:
        - secretRef:
              name: loki-s3-linode-credentials
    maxUnavailable: 1
    persistence:
        claims:
            - accessModes:
                  - ReadWriteOnce
              name: data
              size: 5Gi
              storageClass: block-storage-retain
        enabled: true
    replicas: 3
    resources:
        limits:
            cpu: "1"
            memory: 3Gi
        requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 512Mi
    zoneAwareReplication:
        enabled: false
loki:
    commonConfig:
        replication_factor: 1
    image:
        repository: docker/grafana/loki
    ingester:
        chunk_encoding: snappy
    podAnnotations:
        sidecar.istio.io/inject: "false"
    querier:
        max_concurrent: 4
    schemaConfig:
        configs:
            - from: 2020-09-07
              index:
                  period: 24h
                  prefix: index_
              object_store: s3
              schema: v13
              store: tsdb
    storage:
        bucketNames:
            admin: gsap-apl-loki-chunks-prod
            chunks: gsap-apl-loki-chunks-prod
            ruler: gsap-apl-loki-chunks-prod
        s3:
            backoff_config:
                max_period: 5s
                min_period: 2s
            http_config:
                idle_conn_timeout: 90s
                insecure_skip_verify: true
            s3: https://us-ord-1.linodeobjects.com
            s3ForcePathStyle: true
    storage_config:
        tsdb_shipper:
            active_index_directory: /var/loki/tsdb_index
            cache_location: /var/loki/tsdb_index_cache
            cache_ttl: 24h
    structuredConfig:
        limits_config:
            discover_service_name:
                - app
                - deployment
                - service
                - application
                - app_name
                - name
                - app_kubernetes_io_name
                - container
                - container_name
                - k8s_container_name
                - component
                - workload
                - job
                - k8s_job_name
            otlp_config:
                resource_attributes:
                    attributes_config:
                        - action: index_label
                          attributes:
                              - app
                              - component
                              - container
                              - deployment
                              - namespace
                              - node_name
                    ignore_defaults: true
lokiCanary:
    enabled: false
memcachedExporter:
    enabled: false
monitoring:
    serviceMonitor:
        enabled: true
        labels:
            prometheus: system
querier:
    autoscaling:
        enabled: false
        maxReplicas: 3
        minReplicas: 1
        targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
        targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80
    extraEnvFrom:
        - secretRef:
              name: loki-s3-linode-credentials
    replicas: 1
    resources:
        limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 256Mi
        requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 144Mi
queryFrontend:
    autoscaling:
        enabled: false
        maxReplicas: 3
        minReplicas: 1
        targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
        targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80
    extraContainers:
        - args:
              - run
              - --port=3101
              - --loki-server=http://localhost:3100
              - --auth-config=/etc/reverse-proxy-conf/authn.yaml
          image: mirror.registry.linodelke.net/docker/k8spin/loki-multi-tenant-proxy:v1.0.0
          name: reverse-proxy
          ports:
              - containerPort: 3101
                name: auth
                protocol: TCP
          resources:
              limits:
                  cpu: 100m
                  memory: 32Mi
              requests:
                  cpu: 50m
                  memory: 16Mi
          volumeMounts:
              - mountPath: /etc/reverse-proxy-conf
                name: reverse-proxy-auth-config
    extraEnvFrom:
        - secretRef:
              name: loki-s3-linode-credentials
    extraPorts:
        - name: http
          port: 3101
          protocol: TCP
          targetPort: http
    extraVolumes:
        - name: reverse-proxy-auth-config
          secret:
              secretName: reverse-proxy-auth-config
    podAnnotations:
        checksum/team-config: 781a4ed4ad76d983cf80a8ce0f9fcf283cde39de53b3dd8f9517f4fea362e3d0
    replicas: 1
    resources:
        limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 256Mi
        requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
queryScheduler:
    autoscaling:
        enabled: false
        maxReplicas: 3
        minReplicas: 1
        targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
        targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80
    extraEnvFrom:
        - secretRef:
              name: loki-s3-linode-credentials
    replicas: 1
    resources:
        limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 256Mi
        requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
read:
    replicas: 0
resultsCache:
    enabled: false
ruler:
    enabled: false
sidecar:
    image:
        repository: quay/kiwigrid/k8s-sidecar
    resources:
        limits:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 100Mi
        requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 50Mi
singleBinary:
    replicas: 0
test:
    enabled: false
write:
    replicas: 0
